assertion_analysis.text: assert environment is not None, 'the launcher was handed no environment' - fails if _start_watch_producer stops passing env= to its Popen; demonstrated by the declared negative control, whose log ends EXIT=1 with this test failing.

assert name not in environment, name - fails if SESSION_IDENTITY_ENV_NAMES or the CLAUDE_CODE_ prefix drops one of the six names, since the test sets each through monkeypatch.setenv and reads the value back out of the environment the code composed.

assert harness is None, name - for CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CODEX_SESSION_ID and CODEX_THREAD_ID it fails if the list fails to cover the variable; for CLAUDE_PID it cannot fail because _coordinator_runtime returns early without CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, and the MESSAGING iterations never reach a reader that consults those names.

assert name not in environment, name (supervisor case) - fails if the pops in _WATCH_PRODUCER_SUPERVISOR are removed, because the stub producer records its own os.environ and the test reads it back from the file.

assert coordinator['runtime_session_id'] is None and assert coordinator['harness'] is None - fails if the scrubbed environment still resolves a session through dispatch_accounting._coordinator_runtime when recovery.dispatch_review_for_run composes the review.

assert written == b"" on a live session-host FIFO - fails if the dispatch wrote a session-host request, which a leaked identity would do; the FIFO is held open by a reader so a leaked request would be visible.

findings.text: follow-on: the loop at test_a_watcher_carries_no_session_identity.py:133-148 sets each of the six identity variables alone, scrubs, and asserts _coordinator_runtime() names no harness and _session_host_owner() returns None, but its CLAUDE_PID-alone and CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET/TOKEN-alone iterations cannot fail whatever the code does: dispatch_accounting._coordinator_runtime (reckon/crew/dispatch_accounting.py:125-152) reads CLAUDE_PID only after CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is non-empty, and never reads the MESSAGING variables, so with any one of those three set alone both readers already return None with or without the scrub and the assertion is vacuous for the variable it means to cover. The negative control is unaffected (it reddens case (a) at :112-114, which asserts the three names directly through _without_session_identity), so no real gap is left, but three of the six iterations are not the guard the docstring at :121-125 describes.

follow-on: the head suite arm recorded at after-suite-head.log:71 has one added failure against the baseline (tests/test_stale_producer_warning_waits_for_its_reload.py::test_a_reload_handed_through_crew_follow_defers_the_mismatch), so the done-when clause 'the test files importing reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py or reckon/crew_follow_commands.py show no added failure against base' is not demonstrated by the artefact the manifest carries; after-suite-head.log:70 shows the cause was a dirty tree ('tracked files are modified against HEAD ... keeping the current image'), which is independent of the semantic change, and the manifest claims a clean-tree re-run passes 1 passed EXIT=0 without naming a log for it, so the measure rests on a claim rather than a recorded result.
